title: Native finite-coefficient forward compact-support product
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring and let $p:P\to X$, $q:P\to Z$, $f:X\to B$, $g:Z\to B$ form a Cartesian square [def-pc-fibre-product]. Use ordinary fixed-$A$ small pro-etale derived categories, derived pullback, tensor and symmetry [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. Supply compactifications of $f,g,q,qg$, assume $q,g$ quasi-compact, and let $M\in D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ and $N\in D(Z_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$. Assume $W=Lp^*M\otimes_A^LLq^*N$ is bounded below of etale origin [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness]. Define
$$\Xi_{f,g}(M,N):Rf_!M\otimes_A^LRg_!N\longrightarrow R(qg)_!W$$
to be the following composite, with the specified forward projection and exchange maps [def-exchange-projection]: tensor symmetry; $\mathrm{PF}_g$; tensor symmetry inside $Rg_!$; $Rg_!(\mathrm{Ex}_{!,f,g}\otimes1)$; $Rg_!(\mathrm{PF}_q)$; canonical change from the base-changed compactification of $f$ to the chosen compactification of $q$; and the normalized compact-support compositor of [thm-sf-comp-composition]. The last two comparisons are evaluated on the supplied etale-origin domain. This definition assumes neither invertibility of the forward projection maps nor a symmetry equation for $\Xi$.

lean.statement:
def finiteForwardProduct [HasCompactification f] [HasCompactification g]
    [HasCompactification q] [HasCompactification (q ≫ g)]
    [QuasiCompact q] [QuasiCompact g]
    (sq : IsPullback p q f g)
    (M : _root_.DerivedCategory (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)))
    (N : _root_.DerivedCategory (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Z) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)))
    (hMN : DerivedCategory.plusEtaleOrigin (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) P
      (((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) P).obj
        (L(upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) p).obj M)).obj
        (L(upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) q).obj N))) :
    ((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) B).obj
        ((rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).obj M)).obj
        ((rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) g).obj N) ⟶
      (rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (q ≫ g)).obj
        (((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) P).obj
          (L(upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) p).obj M)).obj
          (L(upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) q).obj N))
